ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure marks the cities and transportation lines of Guangxi and surrounding areas. Wuzhou is located on the right side of the figure, toward the east, close to a river channel; Liuzhou is located northwest of Wuzhou, and Nanning is located in the southern part of the figure, toward the west. Rivers and multiple major transportation lines can be seen in the figure. Liuzhou and Nanning have relatively obvious connections with the regional inland transportation trunk lines, while Wuzhou more prominently has a location along river water transport. Then infer: Wuzhou was once the largest city in Guangxi, indicating that it once relied on convenient river transport conditions to form a development advantage; later Liuzhou and Nanning developed beyond Wuzhou, indicating that with the rise of land transportation modes such as railways and highways, transportation advantages shifted, and the urban development pattern also changed accordingly. Therefore, this indicates that changes in transportation modes have a great impact on the development of cities along the lines.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：在区域图中找到梧州、柳州、南宁的位置，观察它们与河流和交通干线的关系。梧州位于河流交通便利的位置，说明其过去可能因水运发达而兴盛；柳州和南宁则在图中与后来的陆上交通干线联系更明显。再结合题干“梧州曾是最大城市，后来落后于柳州和南宁”，判断城市兴衰不是单纯由行政地位决定，而是由于交通优势发生转移。最后概括为：交通运输方式的改变会显著影响沿线城市的发展。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中标出了广西及周边地区的城市和交通线。梧州位于图的右侧偏东位置，靠近河流通道；柳州位于梧州西北方向，南宁位于图中南部偏西位置。图中可见河流以及多条交通干线，柳州、南宁与区域内陆上交通干线的联系较明显，而梧州更突出沿江水运位置。再推理：梧州过去曾是广西最大的城市，说明它曾依靠便利的河运条件形成发展优势；后来柳州、南宁发展超过梧州，说明随着铁路、公路等陆上交通方式兴起，交通优势发生转移，城市发展格局也随之改变。因此，这表明交通运输方式的改变会对沿线城市的发展产生很大影响。
method.model_answer: 交通运输方式的改变，对沿线城市的发展影响很大。
